title: Fixes three bugs in coreutils-from:
description:
Fixes three bugs in coreutils-from:
  * d/coreutils-from-uutils.links:
    - Reinstate chown and chmod links (LP: #2146312).
    - Remove b3sum link (LP: #2127231).
  * d/control: Add libdigest-sha3-perl << 1.05-1ubuntu3 to Break and
    replace to accommodate the bug fix for LP: #2137443.

PPA: ppa:varranvar/fix2146312-2137443-2127231

Steps to test:

# lxc launch ubuntu-daily:resolute tester
# lxc exec tester -- bash
# sudo apt update
# sudo apt install coreutils-from-uutils
# ls -l /usr/bin/b3sum

This should indicate that /usr/bin/b3sum exists and is a symlink.

# ls -lL /usr/bin/b3sum

This should fail, indicating that the symlink is dangling.

# sudo add-apt-repository ppa:varranvar/fix2146312-2137443-2127231
# sudo apt update
# apt install libdigest-sha3-perl
# sudo apt -y install coreutils-from-uutils
# ls -l /usr/bin/b3sum

This should fail, indicating that /usr/bin/b3sum no longer exists.
